messages:
Nora: Quick morning shoutout 11 to Diego and Hannah for the late-night printer jam rescue and the rescue-bag of snacks they left in the lobby. Seriously saved my sanity and my caffeine. :pray:

Diego: Printer was possessed. We performed the ancient ritual (pull, wait, reseat) and it spat out the slides. Happy to help! :mechanical_arm:

Hannah: Also stole everyone's hearts by bringing mini muffins. Not pictured: crumb trail. 

Ben: Saw the crumb trail 7. Place is a crime scene of deliciousness. Huge thanks to both. :clap:

Rina: Small ask: can we make a tiny post-it checklist for the printer area? "Is paper loaded? Is jam cleared? Is toner low?" Would save future midnight archaeology.

Olivia: Can we also codify "if you rescue, leave a snack" as an unofficial policy? ":sunglasses:"

kudos-bot: +1 Diego, +1 Hannah. Reaction :tada: added by 3 people. Thread auto-saved to #random.

Nora: Love the idea of a snack-for-service policy. Also adding a one-line kudos spot on the fridge next to the milk. Thanks again, team 11
